name: Feature a season
description: Platform admin only: names which of a game's seasons is FEATURED -- the one current_season() and web's 'no season' read resolve to (S4). Featured is a game attribute (games.featured_season_id), set to the season the slug names, so a game shows the season an admin chose rather than only the newest. A private season is never featured (S4), so the write gates on visibility = 'public' and a private season writes nothing: `why` then reads the season's existence and visibility back so 404 (no such game or season) and 422 (it exists but is private) are told apart, and a stranger cannot map a private season by the status code. Write, then diagnose. Setting it moves what every 'no season' public read resolves to, so the write invalidates season + ladder.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('found', s.id IS NOT NULL, 'visibility', s.visibility) AS body FROM games g LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.game_id = g.id AND s.slug = ($2)::text WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

body.detail: A private season is never featured: a featured season is what a game shows to everyone.

with.name: A private season cannot be featured

input.query: SELECT season_json(s) AS body FROM seasons s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND s.slug = ($2)::text
